lessons.title: At the gift shop
lessons.en:
Anna: This silk scarf is so beautiful! What colour do you prefer?
Ben: I'll take the red one. May I try on this hat too?
Shopkeeper: Sure. The size looks perfect.
Ben: How much is everything?
Shopkeeper: Two hundred yuan. Here is your receipt.
lessons.cn:
安娜：这条丝巾真漂亮！你喜欢什么颜色？
本：我要红色。也可以试戴这顶帽子吗？
店主：当然，尺寸正好。
本：一共多少钱？
店主：两百元，这是您的收据。

lessons.title: A good souvenir
lessons.en: A souvenir is a small gift that helps us remember a trip. When I went to Hangzhou, I bought a paper fan with a flower picture. When Dad went to Yunnan, he brought back a small silver hat for me. Choose a souvenir you really like — its size, colour and meaning all matter. Years later, it will still remind you of a happy day.
lessons.cn: 纪念品是帮我们记住旅行的小礼物。我去杭州买了一把画花的纸扇。爸爸从云南带回一顶小银帽给我。挑你真正喜欢的纪念品——尺寸、颜色、意义都重要。多年后它仍能让你想起开心的日子。
